pages.text: CyberFarm grows in $(l)three tiers$(). Each tier is built from what the tier before it makes, so you always know what to build next. This section covers the materials and the machines that make them.

$(li)$(l)**1$()**: $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum$(/l), $(l:materials/circuits)Basic Circuits$(/l), $(l:materials/electrolyzer)Electrolyzer$(/l), a crafting table or the $(l:materials/fabricator)Fabricator$(/l), Basic and Mini Drone Frames, modules, addons, docks, the Assembler, Bio-Digester, Gas Turbine, Methane Extractor, Acid Synthesizer, Pyrolysis Oven, Water Pump
pages.title: The three tiers

pages.text: $(li)$(l)**2$()**: $(l:materials/carbon_fiber)Carbon Fiber$(/l), $(l:materials/circuits)Advanced Circuits$(/l), $(l:materials/pyrolysis_oven)Pyrolysis Oven$(/l) (methane), Fabricator (acid), Advanced Frames, Steam Engine, Coolant Mixer, Waste Reprocessor, Advanced cables, Resonance Core, Mech Hangar, Laser Turret, the dishes

$(li)$(l)**3$()**: $(l:materials/circuits)Elite Circuits$(/l), Fabricator (acid, uranium), Elite Frames, the Fission Reactor, the Steam Turbine, Elite cables, the Crystallizer, Range Module III and the mech

$(li)$(l)By hand$(): mine $(l)bauxite$() and smelt it into alumina. Run a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) and an Electrolyzer for your first aluminum. Craft your first Basic Circuits at a crafting table.
pages.title: The path

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Gas$(): the Advanced Circuits are etched with $(l)Acid$(), made from Nether $(l)sulfur$(). The Carbon Fiber is drawn out of $(l)Methane$() from a $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l). Both need the gas tier of $(l:generators/generators)Generators$(/l).$(br)$(li)$(l)Nuclear$(): the Elite Circuits need $(l)uranium$(), and the $(l:nuclear/nuclear)reactor$(/l) needs Elite Circuits.

Like real drones, the frames start in light $(l)aluminum$() and move on to $(l)carbon fiber$().$(br2)Most of these machines are small multiblocks: each needs one or more $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frames$(/l) beside it before it works.
